newsitem.title: GERMANY: Four Germans kidnapped in Yemen, Bonn says.
newsitem.headline: Four Germans kidnapped in Yemen, Bonn says.

text.p: Four German tourists have been kidnapped in Yemen, the German foreign ministry said on Friday.
A ministry spokeswoman said the two men and two women had been abducted on Thursday. She declined to give any details on the circumstances of the kidnapping.

Earlier this month, a group of seven German tourists on a motorcycle tour in Yemen were also kidnapped. They were held hostage by Yemeni tribesmen and released unharmed after more than a week in captivity.
The ministry spokeswoman said crisis centres had been set up in Bonn and at the German embassy in the Yemeni capital Sanaa to deal with the latest kidnapping.
